g.text: Dash node TH PCB (hw/dash, rev 2.0): 30-pin ESP32 DevKit = Pi supervisor + haptic knob + CAN, 2DIN opening (D47).

g.desc: Dash node TH PCB (hw/dash, rev 2.0): 30-pin ESP32 DevKit = Pi supervisor + haptic knob + CAN, 2DIN opening (D47).

g.text: Power: 3V3 from power module J5 (J20). 3V3_SW (Q10) feeds the CAN transceiver + AS5600, off in sleep.

g.desc: Power: 3V3 from power module J5 (J20). 3V3_SW (Q10) feeds the CAN transceiver + AS5600, off in sleep.

g.text: CAN junction: ME221 (J21) + RJ45 to main (J12 pins 1/2) + Pi HAT stub (J22); no 120 ohm on the dash (mid-bus).

g.desc: CAN junction: ME221 (J21) + RJ45 to main (J12 pins 1/2) + Pi HAT stub (J22); no 120 ohm on the dash (mid-bus).

g.desc: Knob: SimpleFOC Mini off-board on cable J19 (VM from module J2), AS5600 (J24, I2C), push switch (J25).

g.text: Car inputs IGN/ACC (J26) through inverting NPN stages; Pi handshake on J23.
